item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 20/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Wipha will move across the vicinity of the coast of western Guangdong and towards Beibu Wan tomorrow. Under the influence of its associated rainbands, there will still be showers and squally thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. The weather is expected to improve gradually over the region in the latter part of this week. However, a broad trough of low pressure will bring showers to the northern part of the South China Sea. A southwesterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China early next week.

Wind: Southeast force 6 to 7 at first, up to force 8 offshore and on high ground. Southeast force 5 later.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional squally showers and thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times. Seas will be rough with swells.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
